decision_basis: All 240 exact remote readbacks differ from the candidate parent while candidate content equals the candidate parent. The candidate therefore has no recorded change for any review_required path and would replace a remote-only change. No trusted remote commit/parent or owner-approved preservation decision exists; no overwrite or merge is authorized. Two host source archives were also probed read-only; neither contains Git metadata and neither matches all current remote bytes (163/240 and 123/240), so neither supplies a trusted remote base. A broader read-only search found no Git bundle, checkout HEAD, packed refs, or commit metadata under the host release/archive roots.

host_archive_probe.probe: find /opt /var/lib/merchant-release-security for Git bundles, packed refs, HEAD, source-head, commit metadata
host_archive_probe.result: no Git bundle, checkout metadata, or commit metadata found; four unrelated source-head files only
